blocks.html: Star Buds is your neighborhood dispensary. We provide a comfortable setting to learn about and purchase all types of cannabis products. Our carefully curated selection includes: flower, concentrates, edibles and topicals. We have something for everyone… from the occasional smoker to the daily consumer. We strive to educate customers, normalize usage and contribute to our local communities.
